messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P0 - KV prefix hit-rate collapse observed for tenant CobaltBank (dedicated-pool us-east-1-dedicated-42). API errors rising, tail latency spiking. root_ts=2078005555
eli: ack. I'm on it. Prioritize KV prefix hit-rate diagnostics + check recent config changes.
priya: seen on dashboards — prefix 'cobalt:/user/' hit_rate dropped to ~2% from ~78% over the last 10m. Prefetch queue spiked; looks like lots of short-lived prefixes (possible bulk ingest pollution).
jordan: pulling logs from gpux-12 and KV metrics now. If prefetch is the culprit we can disable per-tenant prefetch quickly.
eli: run these to pull live stats:
```
curl -sS http://metrics-api.internal/pools/us-east-1-dedicated-42/kv?tenant=cobaltbank
# or
ssh ops@gpux-12 'tail -n 200 /var/log/kv-service.log | grep cobalt'
```
jordan: paste of recent KV stats:
```
KV_PUT rate=2400/s
KV_GET hit_rate=0.021
prefetch_queue_len=1.2k
eviction_rate=4.5k/s
```
nadia: CS on standby. DM'd CobaltBank: "we're investigating increased errors and latency on your dedicated pool; may perform mitigations that could cause brief throttling." They want ETA.
eli: mitigation plan (short):
- immediate: disable tenant prefetch on pool
- short: targeted eviction of problematic prefixes (cobalt:/bulk_ingest/) and increase TTLs for user prefixes
- short/medium: apply temporary rate-limit to ingest route
- fallback: failover routing to shared pool if needed
- long: shard tenant prefixes or provision hot pool for heavy ingest
priya: quick admin payload to disable prefetch:
```
PUT /admin/pools/us-east-1-dedicated-42/config
{
  "tenant_overrides": {
    "cobaltbank": { "prefetch_enabled": false }
  }
}
```
jordan: starting infra job infra apply --job disable-prefetch-cobalt-2078 now. job id will be posted.
jordan: job started id=job-9042 — ETA ~45s.
oncall-bot: job job-9042 succeeded (45s). prefetch toggle confirmed off for cobaltbank.
eli: monitoring hit-rate after toggle.
priya: keep kv:metrics retention high for 1h so we can capture fine-grained samples.
jordan: new metrics 3m after toggle:
```
KV_GET hit_rate=0.19
prefetch_queue_len=120
eviction_rate=800/s
```
improving but still below baseline.
nadia: Cobalt asked for timeline; I told them we expect error reduction within 10-20m, will confirm.
eli: next step: targeted eviction for prefix cobalt:/bulk_ingest/:
```
admin-cli evict-prefix --tenant cobaltbank --prefix "cobalt:/bulk_ingest/" --dry-run=false
```
(note: will evict cached artifacts; correctness unaffected but cached responses will be regenerated)
jordan: eviction started — logs showing ~1.3M keys removed across pool.
priya: post-eviction metrics: hit_rate=0.62, p95 latency ~180ms. Good improvement.
eli: set temporary rate-limit for ingest route to prevent immediate repollution:
```
rate-limit set --tenant cobaltbank --route /v1/ingest --qps 50
```
nadia: told CobaltBank we applied prefetch off + eviction + rate-limit. They reported error rate dropped and are monitoring. They asked for RCA and when prefetch will be re-enabled.
eli: agreed — keep prefetch off for 24h, re-evaluate with controlled canary.
eli: ACTIONS:
- eli: monitor metrics for 24h and produce incident timeline + root cause (likely prefetch policy + bulk ingest pattern)
- priya: prepare canary plan to re-enable prefetch under throttling and run tests
- jordan: upload eviction artifacts & exact key counts + infra logs
- nadia: follow up with CobaltBank and draft customer communication/RCA
oncall-bot: handoff scheduled: next oncall @jordan in 30m. Incident status: active -> mitigated. :white_check_mark:
